# Cleveland Containers®

Cleveland Containers® is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Cleveland Containers is a company that offers one of the largest nationwide stocks of new and used shipping containers, available throughout the UK. They provide a wide range of shipping containers for sale and hire. Cleveland Containers® employs 59 people (+9.3% YoY, +5 people) and has an annual revenue of $73.7M, founded in 2011. Headquartered in Stockton-on-Tees, England, United Kingdom, with offices in Stockton On Tees and Grangetown.

## About

Based in Middlesbrough, we are one of the UK’s leading suppliers of shipping containers.

We can offer sizes to fit your needs, from a small shipping container, through to our largest supplied shipper container at 45ft, as well as providing bespoke and modular conversions.

You can use a shipping container for so much more than just shipping and storage. They can be converted into a range of applications including pop-up shops, bars, restaurants and office spaces, with options almost endless. They’re growing in popularity in a range of industries too, such as agriculture, construction and retail.

Our experienced technicians are trained to deliver your shipping containers with expertise, efficiency and accuracy, whilst our friendly sales team are here to cater to your every need. With a modern fleet of delivery vehicles, we also ensure that your shipping container delivery is dealt with quickly and carefully. We are focussed on making your experience as easy, speedy and pleasant as possible, delivering exactly what you want, when you want it and how you want it.
